choice: Scoped ZIP-imported tools to the importing group to prevent unauthorized modification of another group’s data.
final:
Fixed a cross-group IDOR in ZIP imports: crafted tool IDs could overwrite and take ownership of another group’s tools. Imports now resolve tools within the importing group.

Added regression coverage; all 21 ZIP import tests passed with `python3 -m pytest`.

CHOICE: Scoped ZIP-imported tools to the importing group to prevent unauthorized modification of another group’s data.
